subtopics: Chapter N UTRITION Food is needed by all living organisms mainly for growth and repair.
Several organisms need food to maintain body temperature as well.
A variety of substances are taken as food by organisms from single celluar organisms like amoeba to the complex multicellular organisms like the human being.
You have studied in the previous classes about how different organisms get their food.
Let us study about autotrophic and heterotrophic modes of nutrition and also find out why most of the plants are called as autotrophs.
They acquire nutrients like mineral salts and water from the soil as well as some gases from the air.
Most of the food that we eat is obtained from plants.
Even if we depend on animal products, we would find that those animals usually depend on plants for their food.
But how do plants carry out their life processes?
You have studied something about photosynthesis in your earlier classes.
Investigations into plant life processes might have started long ago.
Actual experimentations to know about plant needs have been recorded from 17th century.

subtopics: What are the end products formed after the digestion of fats?
Transport of the products of digestion from the intestine into blood (through the wall of small intestine) is called absorption.
Internally, intestinal wall has a number of finger like projections called Microvilli.
Products of digestion are absorbed first into the villi and from there into the blood vessels.
This means the digested food absorbed by the walls of the small intestine.
Thus after maximum absorption of food in the small intestine the rest passes into the large intestine which is undigested.

subtopics: Examine some mustard seedlings which have been grown.
Observe the mass of fine threads coming from the seed by hand lens.
They have fine microscopic structures called root hairs.
Note the thinness of the walls of root hairs.
Osmosis plays an important role in movement of water from root hairs to xylem.
Every living cell acts as an osmotic system, the cytoplasm lining of the cell wall acts as the semipermeable membrane.
The soil water is an extremely dilute solution of salts.
Soil water concentration is more dilute than that of the cellsap in the root hair; therefore water will pass into the vacuole of the root hair by osmosis.
Recall the process of osmosis that you have learnt in the chapter “moving of substances through plasma membrane” in class IX.
As there are vast number of root hairs and root cells involved, a pressure in the xylem vessels develops which forces the water upwards.
This total pressure is known as root pressure.
Root pressure is not the main cause of movement of water in xylem but it is certainly one of the factor.

subtopics: Report: 1 Jawan from Mahabubnagar killed in Srinagar attack MAHABUBNAGAR: A jawan from Andhra Pradesh was among the eight men of the Indian Army killed in Monday’s terror attack in Srinagar.
Yadaiah (28) was from Mahabubnagar district, officials said.
His body is likely to be flown into Hyderabad on Thursday.

The drainage system in India has evolved and adjusted itself with the evolution of the three physiographic units: 1) the Himalayas 2) peninsular plateau and 3) the Indo- Gangetic plain.
On the basis of its origin, the drainage system in India can be broadly divided into two categories: i) The Himalayan rivers and ii) The Peninsular rivers.
They first N flow parallel to the main axis of the mountains.
Then, they take a sudden bend towards the south cutting through the massive mountain chain to reach the north A Indian plains.
In the process, they have carved out deep ‘v’ shaped valleys.
This is because the rivers are supplied on rainfall as well as the melting snow.
N 5.1.1 The Indus System A The Indus originates in the northern slopes of the Kailash range in Tibet near Lake Manasarovar.
It follows a north-westerLly course through Tibet.
The main tributaries With the help of an atlas trace E of the Indus in India are Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas the course of Indus both in India and Sutlej.
They cover Jammu and Kashmir, Punjab T and Pakistan.

A For instance, women in Switzerland got the right to vote only in 1971.

ఈ పసికారు రొండెర్లక నివురు గమ్మిన కొరివి తోటి నెత్తి గోక్కుంట లేరు గదా!
ఇప్పుడు మా బావ పోలీసుపటేలు పాపిరెడ్డికి సాగువాటు సరిగలేదంట సూచాయగ ఇన్న మరి ఆయినేం పచ్చపూస గన్మనా?
ఎన్నాళ్ళంట వీళ్ళ చెప్పుకింద తేళ్ళ తీర్ణ అణిగి మణిగి ఉంటరు?
సన్నకారు మంది అంత ఇప్పుడు అయిందానికి కానిదానికి కయ్యాలకు దిగి కుస్తిపట్లు, పట్టి నెత్తురు కండ్ల జూస్కోని పంచాయితిల పడి ఆ పంచాయితిడార్లకు అప్పు సప్పు జేసి దండుగలు గట్టుకం లేదు.
ఏ వాడన పంచాయితి ఆ వాడనె తీర్పులు జరుగుతుండవి.
ఆడ మా పెదమామ ఇంటిపోంటి ఉన్న గరిసెల ఇండ్లల్ల దీపాలు ఎలిగినట్లు నలుగుర్మమణుసులు, మెసిల్చట్లు జళకళ గలగల సప్పుడు ఇనిపిచ్చింది.
అన్నట్లు మా తమ్ముణి దిక్కుజూసిన, ఎంటనె మా హాజిర్‌ జవాబు ఎక్కళ్ళేని ఉల్లాసం తోటి బుజాన ఏసుకున్న దస్తు రుమాలు జాడిచ్చి దులుపుకుంట “అక్కా!
ఇది మన Sys పల్లకీ nod పాత పొత్తులిల్లు, జనం మెదులక బండ జింకలు జేరి అబ్బో అన్నట్లుంటుండె, అది ఇప్పుడు మనూరికి రాశత్రిబడి ఐంది.
సంబురానికి మెరిమెణ జేసి పగటి దీపాలెలిగిచ్చి ఊరంత మెరిచ్చిన మెరియ్యని ఊరేగింపులు తీసె మగ్దూరు లేదు అంట కట్టడి జేసినం.
ఇంగ మనపెత్తాత కండ్లు నిప్పుకలు RMON, SAS లేక తామసం ఆపుకొని పణమీది చెముటలు చిన్నపంచె తోటి తుడ్సుకుంట బుస్సు బుస్సు మంటుండంగ 'మేమంత ఈ పాత సవారీలను బద్దురంగ గుమ్ములింట్ల అలంకారాలోలె యాళ్ళాడగట్టినం”.
గజ్జెల సప్పుడు ఇని ఆ సుట్టుపక్కల పిల్లలంత ఉరుక్కుంటొచ్చి సుట్టు జుట్టుకున్నరు.
